About the job

Remarcable is the intelligent procurement and material operations platform
transforming how trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) and suppliers
work together. Processing over $1B in monthly purchase volume, our platform
unifies procurement, inventory, prefabrication, tool management, and delivery.
We connect live field operations, back offices, and suppliers through real time
data sync, visual catalogs, side by side distributor pricing, AI discrepancy
detection, and 180+ supplier and ERP integrations.

We are growing our engineering team and hiring across multiple Full Stack
Software Engineer roles at both Intermediate and Senior levels. We are looking
for resourceful, curious engineers to build high-impact software in a
fast-growing SaaS startup. In these roles, you will not get lost in the shuffle.
You will own features end to end, collaborate directly with customers, and
shape product strategy.

What You'll Do

- Feature Engineering: Build and launch end-to-end features across
  Python/Django backends, Angular frontends, and SQL schemas.
- Bug Hunting & Performance: Diagnose and resolve complex edge cases, race
  conditions, and performance bottlenecks across the stack.
- Production Reliability: Troubleshoot high-priority customer issues and
  runtime exceptions in live production environments.
- Code Reviews: Conduct rigorous peer code reviews to enforce quality,
  security, and architectural standards.
- System Integrations: Build and maintain resilient REST APIs, webhooks, email
  parsers, and OCR extraction pipelines.
- Technical Ownership: Document key architecture, data models, and workflows
  to ensure team maintainability.
- Accelerated Growth: Leverage modern AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to speed up
  execution, automate testing, and master new technologies.

Who You Are

- 4-6+ years of professional software engineering experience in a production
  SaaS or fast-paced startup environment.
- 4-6+ years of hands-on experience building backend services with Python and
  Django (or similar frameworks like FastAPI/Flask), including designing
  RESTful APIs, writing asynchronous background jobs and structuring modular
  backend architecture.
- 4+ years of experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL),
  including writing and optimizing complex JOIN queries, designing normalized
  database schemas, creating indexes, and debugging slow ORM queries.
- 2+ years of production experience with modern frontend frameworks
  (specifically Angular, React, or Vue), including state management, component
  architecture, and integration with backend APIs.
- Based in Vancouver (or willing to relocate), working on-site 4 days per week
  out of our downtown office.
- A problem-solver with a customer-first mindset.
- Someone who takes ownership of their work and thrives in a collaborative
  startup team.

Nice to Have

- Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated integration pipelines,
  specifically handling third-party REST/GraphQL APIs, webhook ingestion,
  email processing tools, or document/OCR data extraction workflows.
- Practical experience with Docker, containerized environments, and basic cloud
  infrastructure management using Terraform and Cloud to support automated
  deployment pipelines.
- Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor,
  ChatGPT) to accelerate code generation, write unit tests, and debug complex
  stack traces.

Why Join Remarcable?

Remarcable is a Series A SaaS company revolutionizing how electrical
contractors and distributors do business. Founded by people who know the
industry inside and out, our platform streamlines procurement and tool
management--bringing efficiency, visibility, and better communication to a
market overdue for change.

- Impact: Your work directly shapes the future of our platform.
- Learning & Growth: Work alongside experienced engineers and industry experts.
- Team Culture: Collaborative, fast-paced, and focused on solving real customer
  problems.
- Mission-Driven: We're helping contractors save time, reduce friction, and
  modernize their operations.
